name: Tabs / Settings Sections
description: Settings Sections product scenario for the Tabs component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled selected key; a key missing from `items` shows the first enabled tab until it appears.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Selected key on mount, else the first enabled tab; a key that `items` do not contain yet waits for them.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Axis of the tab list and of its arrow keys.

controls.name: activationMode
controls.description: Automatic selects the tab an arrow key reaches; manual waits for a click, Space or Enter.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables the tabs and header actions; the selected panel stays visible.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Pill background or an underline that follows the selected tab's geometry.

controls.name: wrap
controls.description: Wraps the tab list instead of scrolling along its axis.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each tab; toggling preserves DOM and focus.

controls.name: actions
controls.description: Header controls outside the tablist, such as New, Close selected or More.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the selected enabled tab, else the first enabled one, once on mount.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible name of the tablist, not the generic outer wrapper.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Visible heading IDs naming the tablist.

controls.name: aria-describedby
controls.description: Additional description IDs for the tablist.

controls.name: renderPanels
controls.description: Renders a persistent panel per tab; `false` leaves panels to the consumer, referenced by each item's `panelId`.

controls.name: items
controls.description: The tabs in order, keyed by `value`: label, icon, content, disabled, panelId and native naming (id, title, aria-*). Groups and separators are dropped with a report.
